purpose: Teach: 芥川/ビルマ/ベネズエラ/茅ヶ崎/ナイロビ/鈴鹿/ホノルル/テレビ東京

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが芥川龍之介の童話を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad's going to read us some Akutagawa Ryunosuke fairy tales.
lines.style: Warm, sharing something delightful. Soft opening. The light lift of 'そうよ' at the end — gentle news, not performative. Shoulders relaxed, eyes bright.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとビルマの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I looked at a picture book about Burma with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, unguarded excitement. Quick attack on 'me' — can't wait to share. Bouncy rhythm. The genuine joy of a six-year-old reporting something good. No filter, all presence.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがベネズエラの絵本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad's going to read us a picture book from Venezuela.
lines.style: Gentle, thoughtful pacing. Slight pause before 'picture book' — savoring the idea. The warmth of someone sharing something precious. Eyes soft, not rushed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと茅ヶ崎の海に行ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I went to see the ocean at Chigasaki!
lines.style: Immediate, infectious energy. Quick staccato on the announcement. That breathless quality of a child who's been holding the story in. Simple joy, no modulation needed.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがナイロビ出張のお土産下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad brought back a souvenir from his business trip to Nairobi.
lines.style: Warm and knowing. Gentle emphasis on 'souvenir' — the thoughtfulness behind it. Steady, unhurried. The voice of someone who understands what small things mean.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと鈴鹿のF1観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad took me to see Formula One at Suzuka!
lines.style: Pure, unfiltered excitement. Quick bright attack. Breathless rhythm — words tumbling out. The peak of a child's joy, no restraint. Eyes wide, voice high and clear.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがホノルル旅行に連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad's going to take us on a trip to Honolulu.
lines.style: Tender opening, building warmth. The 'へ' at 'Honolulu' carries slight wonder. Steady, measured — letting the excitement be quiet and real. Genuine happiness, not performed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとテレビ東京のドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I watched a documentary on TV Tokyo with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, still excited, slightly more settled than before. The rhythm steady but alive. Genuine pride in sharing an adult moment. Voice clear, face open, the small pride of having done something with Dad.
